entry_state: The corporate package connects dated economic preconditions,quantity changes,postings and statement mapping. Unknown residuals cannot become balancing events. Scenario types distinguish stress,observation and intervention;decision-time information excludes future realizations. Funding failure retains an unpaid obligation,while unsupported computation retains an incomplete branch. The next chapter must explain how uncertainty and inference operate on these preserved alternatives.
exit_state: Chapter9 develops operating-company accounting methods before the later uncertainty discussion. Distinct books preserve treatment differences;the inventory example demonstrates their numerical effect. Revenue,unconditional billing,advances and collection are separate transitions. Applied advances reduce both unused credit and the amount still owed;even a zero-money invoice must atomically consume its credit. The next example examines a sale with a surviving return right.
findings: Correction to the preceding review note:its prediction that uncertainty was the next chapter was mistaken. The actual next chapter is operating-company accounting. This is a reviewer expectation correction,not a manuscript defect or changed reading credit.

The common-core discussion explicitly distinguishes dated source authority,issuer policy and unresolved current ASC/ASBE authority. FIFO64,LIFO80 and average72 cost of sales follow from the matched purchases and twelve-unit sale.

The advance extension defines T=G+A-K and proves net assets equal earned revenue. It preserves invoice/advance state even when monetary journals are empty;native acquisition-schema support is explicitly absent. No confirmed new defect.
